description: This file is a Python module that provides functions and classes for launching and managing multiple worker processes, either as functions or binaries, in a distributed training or processing environment. It includes the main function start_processes and references various classes and constants related to process management and logging.

classes.name: MultiprocessContext
classes.description: Base class for managing multiple processes launched as functions.

classes.name: PContext
classes.description: Parent class for process context, providing interface for process management.

classes.name: SubprocessContext
classes.description: Class for managing subprocesses launched as binaries.

methods.name: start_processes
methods.description: Main function to start multiple worker processes, either as functions or binaries, with specified configurations.
